name: Apogee Lens Spire

mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Will installing the Sanctum Prism-Gyro focus the starlight bridge into the Nebula Undertide?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northern optical transmitter of The Eclipse Observatory pointing toward Nebula Undertide.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Levitating quartz lenses crowned by a violet corona of refracted starlight.
